cargo-binary-and-library: src/cli.rs [tests] cargo-test  run: cargo test --bin case_binlib -- cli::
T tests > in_bin_module => cargo test --bin case_binlib -- cli::tests::in_bin_module --exact
src/main.rs [tests] cargo-test  run: cargo test --bin case_binlib
T tests > in_bin => cargo test --bin case_binlib -- tests::in_bin --exact
src/shared.rs [tests] cargo-test  run: cargo test --lib -- shared::
T tests > in_lib => cargo test --lib -- shared::tests::in_lib --exact
cargo-feature-gated: T tests > always => cargo test --lib -- tests::always --exact
cargo-integration-tests: tests/api.rs [tests] cargo-test  run: cargo test --test api
T adds => cargo test --test api -- adds --exact
T more > adds => cargo test --test api -- more::adds --exact
tests/suite/main.rs [tests] cargo-test  run: cargo test --test suite
T whole => cargo test --test suite -- whole --exact
tests/suite/part.rs [tests] cargo-test  run: cargo test --test suite -- part::
T piece => cargo test --test suite -- part::piece --exact
cargo-library: T tests > adds => cargo test --lib -- tests::adds --exact
T tests > slow => cargo test --lib -- tests::slow --exact --include-ignored
T tests > inner > adds => cargo test --lib -- tests::inner::adds --exact
src/util.rs [tests] cargo-test  run: cargo test --lib -- util::
T tests > adds => cargo test --lib -- util::tests::adds --exact
T tests > adds_more => cargo test --lib -- util::tests::adds_more --exact
cargo-workspace-member: crates/one/src/lib.rs [tests] cargo-test  run: (cd crates/one && cargo test --lib)
T tests > member => (cd crates/one && cargo test --lib -- tests::member --exact)
dotnet-xunit: T FooTests > Inner > Adds => dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName=My.App.Tests.FooTests+Inner.Adds
T Concrete > Inherited (from FooTests.cs:35) => dotnet test --filter FullyQualifiedName=My.App.Tests.Concrete.Inherited
go-nested-module-and-packages: svc/a/a_test.go [tests] go-test  run: (cd svc && go test ./a)

svc/b/b_test.go [tests] go-test  run: (cd svc && go test ./b)
svc/b/mark_test.go [tests] go-test  run: (cd svc && go test ./b)

jest-script: src/sum.test.js [tests] jest  run: npx jest --runTestsByPath src/sum.test.js
T sum > adds => npx jest --runTestsByPath src/sum.test.js -t '^sum adds$'
T sum > adds more => npx jest --runTestsByPath src/sum.test.js -t '^sum adds more$'
T sum > edge > adds => npx jest --runTestsByPath src/sum.test.js -t '^sum edge adds$'
T sum > edge > handles $ and ^ (really) => npx jest --runTestsByPath src/sum.test.js -t '^sum edge handles \$ and \^ \(really\)$'
T other > adds => npx jest --runTestsByPath src/sum.test.js -t '^other adds$'

maven-junit4-and-inherited: T ChildTest > shared (from src/test/java/com/x/BaseChecks.java:9) => mvn test '-Dtest=com.x.ChildTest#shared'
T OnlyInheritsTest > shared (from src/test/java/com/x/BaseChecks.java:9) => mvn test '-Dtest=com.x.OnlyInheritsTest#shared'
maven-junit5: T FooTest > Inner > adds => mvn test '-Dtest=com.x.FooTest$Inner#adds'
maven-nested-classes: T OuterTest > Plain > inStatic [conditional] => mvn test '-Dtest=com.x.OuterTest$Plain#inStatic'
T OuterTest > Deep > Deeper > bottom => mvn test '-Dtest=com.x.OuterTest$Deep$Deeper#bottom'
mocha-script: test/a.test.js [tests] mocha  run: npx mocha test/a.test.js
T queue > pushes => npx mocha test/a.test.js --grep '^queue pushes$'
T queue > when empty > pops nothing => npx mocha test/a.test.js --grep '^queue when empty pops nothing$'
T queue > when empty > pushes => npx mocha test/a.test.js --grep '^queue when empty pushes$'
T stack > pushes => npx mocha test/a.test.js --grep '^stack pushes$'
mocha-shared-behaviour: test/fifo.test.js [tests] mocha  run: npx mocha test/fifo.test.js
node-test-by-import-only: T group > inner => node --test --test-name-pattern='^group inner$' test/c.test.js
node-test-name-read-two-ways: T math > subtracts => node --test --test-name-pattern='^math subtracts$' test/n.test.js
T math adds > x => node --test --test-name-pattern='^math adds x$' test/n.test.js
node-test-names-not-written: T plain template => node --test --test-name-pattern='^plain template$' test/e.test.js
node-test-script: T top level => node --test --test-name-pattern='^top level$' test/a.test.js
T math > adds => node --test --test-name-pattern='^math adds$' test/a.test.js
T math > deep > adds => node --test --test-name-pattern='^math deep adds$' test/a.test.js
T text > adds => node --test --test-name-pattern='^text adds$' test/a.test.js
T text > escapes (a+b) [x]? => node --test --test-name-pattern='^text escapes \(a\+b\) \[x\]\?$' test/a.test.js
T text > it's quoted => node --test --test-name-pattern='^text it'\''s quoted$' test/a.test.js
node-test-script-loader: T needs setup => node --test --import ./setup.mjs --test-name-pattern='^needs setup$' test/b.test.js
node-test-typescript-by-script-option: T typed top => node --test --experimental-strip-types --test-name-pattern='^typed top$' test/typed.test.ts
T typed group > inner => node --test --experimental-strip-types --test-name-pattern='^typed group inner$' test/typed.test.ts
